method: Each point re-runs today's index code on the data published by that month (current vintage; ranks use only history up to then, from 1976). Inputs enter once they have 10 years of history, so the early line uses fewer inputs; it is not drawn below half. Household debt/GDP is extended back to 1976 with the Fed's Z.1; debt service starts in 2005 on FRED and enters only in 2015, so readings before then (the 1990, 2001 and 2007 recession-start readings included) lack it. The line's last point is the rebuilt current month (lagged inputs); the dot is today's live reading.
